feeds.title: Balcony Garden Web » DIY
feeds.description: Balcony Garden Web is a popular blog that focuses on gardening in small spaces. With a focus on balcony gardening, the blog provides readers with practical tips and DIY projects to create beautiful and functional outdoor spaces. Founded in 2012, Balcony Garden Web has established itself as a leading resource for urban gardeners.

feeds.title: The Balcony Garden Blog
feeds.description: The Balcony Garden has been working closely with designers, artisans, and international craftsmen since 2006. Using ethically sourced materials and practices, we're proud to bring you our constantly evolving collection of pots and planters. Our passion is to produce handmade pots of the highest quality. Our pots are handpicked from around the globe and are suitable for interiors and outdoors.

feeds.title: BalconyGuide » Planters & Plants
feeds.description: Read articles on Planters & Plants to install in balconies in this segment. BalconyGuide was created to celebrate the joy of having a balcony. We love to spend time on our balcony and try to constantly improve our balcony experience for us and for our readers.
